 News Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 2026 Series Arrives in PH

 · 
 October 29, 2026  ·  3 min read

 🔗 Copy link 
 Related topics 
 #xiaomi 
 #Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 2026 Series 
 Xiaomi has launched the Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 2026 Series in five sizes, from 55 inches to 98 inches, with 1,200 nits of peak brightness and 0.0001-nit blacks across the range. The lineup is on sale now through Xiaomi’s official online store and its Shopee and Lazada stores, and the release gives no prices for any size.
 Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 2026
 The Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 2026 Series covers 55-inch, 65-inch, and 75-inch models which use Quantum Dot Mini LED panels with 308, 384, and 512 local dimming zones respectively, and each runs a 4K panel with 120Hz Game Boost, MEMC interpolation at 4K 60Hz, and HDMI 2.1 auto low latency mode. Their color coverage reaches 94% of DCI-P3 across more than 1.07 billion colors, with HDR10+, HLG, and Filmmaker Mode, and sound comes from dual 15W speakers with Dolby Audio, DTS:X, and Xiaomi Sound processing.
 The 85-inch and 98-inch models step up to high-density backlight arrays with 640 and 880 zones, a 12,000,000:1 dynamic contrast ratio, and 144Hz native 4K that Game Boost can push to 288Hz, with variable refresh rate and three HDMI 2.1 ports for consoles. They add Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos to the same dual 15W speaker setup, and run on a quad Cortex A73 processor with 3GB of RAM, 32GB of storage, Wi-Fi 6, and Bluetooth 5.2. Xiaomi also fits them with 20kHz hybrid dimming and low blue light processing for long sessions.
 Size Local dimming zones Peak brightness Refresh HDR 
 55-inch 308 1,200 nits 120Hz Game Boost HDR10+, HLG, Filmmaker Mode 
 65-inch 384 1,200 nits 120Hz Game Boost HDR10+, HLG, Filmmaker Mode 
 75-inch 512 1,200 nits 120Hz Game Boost HDR10+, HLG, Filmmaker Mode 
 85-inch 640 1,200 nits 144Hz, up to 288Hz Game Boost Dolby Vision 
 98-inch 880 1,200 nits 144Hz, up to 288Hz Game Boost Dolby Vision 
 Across the range, the Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 2026 Series uses a Dark Gray finish with up to a 98% screen-to-body ratio. Every size runs Google TV with hands-free Google Assistant and supports casting through Google Cast and Apple AirPlay. Google TV brings together streaming services, smart-device controls, and personal media in one interface.
 The Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 2026 Series covers both cases. The 55-inch, 65-inch, and 75-inch models suit movie nights and sports broadcasts, while the 85-inch and 98-inch models aim at cinephiles, sports fans, and dedicated gamers who want a larger screen. The bigger pair also carries the stronger gaming specification: 144Hz native 4K, Game Boost up to 288Hz, VRR, and three HDMI 2.1 ports.
 Availability and Pricing
 The Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 2026 Series is available now on Xiaomi’s official online store , the official Xiaomi store on Shopee , and the official Xiaomi store on Lazada . The 65-inch model is priced at PHP 51,990, while the 75-inch model retails for PHP 64,990.
 For more information, visit Xiaomi Philippines .
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
 + What sizes does the Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 2026 Series come in? 
 55, 65, 75, 85, and 98 inches.
 + How much does it cost in the Philippines 
 The 65-inch model is priced at PHP 51,990, while the 75-inch model retails for PHP 64,990.
 + How many dimming zones does each size have? 
 308 on the 55-inch, 384 on the 65-inch, 512 on the 75-inch, 640 on the 85-inch, and 880 on the 98-inch.
 + What is different about the 85-inch and 98-inch models? 
 They move to 144Hz native 4K with Game Boost to 288Hz, add Dolby Vision and Atmos, and gain a 12,000,000:1 dynamic contrast ratio, triple HDMI 2.1 ports, Wi-Fi 6, and a quad Cortex A73 processor with 3GB of RAM and 32GB of storage.
 + Where can I buy one? 
 Xiaomi’s official online store, or the official Xiaomi stores on Shopee and Lazada.
